headline: eBay Raises Outlook After Second-Quarter Earnings Beat
summary: Global e-commerce and auction site  eBay  reported better-than-expected second-quarter earnings and revenue, and raised its full-year forecast on Wednesday afternoon.  For the second quarter ended June 30, eBay reported adjusted earnings of $1.60 a share, up 14%, on revenue of $3.13 billion, up $404 million or 15%.  Gross merchandise volume of $22.4 billion rose 15%, marking the ninth straight quarter of GMV growth, and surpassed the $21.6 billion analysts expected.

headline: eBay (NASDAQ:EBAY) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations, Guides for Strong Sales Next Quarter
summary: Online marketplace eBay (NASDAQ:EBAY) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 14.8% year on year to $3.13 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($3.10 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 4.1% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.60 per share was 6.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
